competences.description: Attacks all enemies to increase their chance of landing a Glancing Hit for 2 turns.

Attacks all enemies 3 times. Each hit removes all beneficial effects with a 50% chance and inflicts Continuous Damage for each beneficial effect removed for 2 turns. Gains 1 stack of Chaos Force whenever attacking an enemy granted with Increase Glancing Hit Chance.

Attacks all enemies. Gains 5 stacks of Chaos Force if the boss attacks an enemy with no beneficial effects. When attacking enemies granted with Increase Glancing Hit Chance, Chaos Force increases by the number of those enemies.

Decreases the HP of all enemies by 1% per stack of Chaos Force, and then attacks all enemies with an attack that ignores all damage reduction effects. The damage dealt increases by 1% per stack of Chaos Force. This attack does not activate passive skills of the enemies.
